title: Upgrade @kanbus/ui in the Board panel from 0.3.1 to 0.4.1 (themes API changes) and pin cdk plus api-client as a pair

comments.author: home
comments.text: From the Kanbus project (2026-10-20): released tags are immutable; the three packages version independently. Pins: @kanbus/cdk 0.2.0 (it bundles kanbus-api, so its version IS the server version: 0.2.0 = Kanbus 0.39.0) and @kanbus/api-client 0.1.0 as a PAIR, upgraded together; @kanbus/ui separately (Chatticus Board panel is on 0.3.1, latest is 0.4.1, which follows the themes work and removes newsprint; expect theme API changes, so test the Board panel screenshots). The api-client issue types (nullable assignee, parent, closed_at) are not identical to @kanbus/ui KanbanIssue: map in the Chatticus adapter. Kanbus is adding a compatibility table (packages/README.md) and GET /api/version on kanbus-api. Also pending on the Kanbus side: flat borderless theme, scoped tokens, explicit read-only prop, narrow layout, pure parsers (kbs-460415fd).
